label: Ventilator
definition: A machine that provides mechanical ventilation to patients.

label: Patient Data
definition: Information collected from patients, which can be recorded manually and/or automatically in medical settings.

label: Outcome Data
definition: Data that reflects the results of treatment and monitoring of patients in intensive care.

label: Brain Injury
definition: A condition resulting from damage to the brain, which can be monitored and treated in intensive care settings.

label: Electrocardiogram (ECG)
definition: A test that records the electrical activity of the heart.

label: Treatment Data
definition: Data related to the treatments administered to patients in intensive care units.

label: Medical Disorders
definition: A category of conditions that may be associated with abnormal recorded values in clinical data.

label: Transcranial Doppler
definition: A non-invasive ultrasound method used to measure blood flow velocity in the brain's blood vessels.

label: Error
definition: An identified issue with a recorded value in patient data.

label: Oesophageal
definition: Relating to the oesophagus, the tube that carries food from the mouth to the stomach.

label: Impedance Plethmography
definition: A non-invasive method to measure changes in blood volume.

label: Bladder
definition: An organ that stores urine.

label: Head Injury
definition: An injury to the head that can result in serious consequences and is a leading cause of death in young males.

label: Machine
definition: A device used in medical evaluations to collect data.

label: Computed Tomography (CT) Scan
definition: An imaging technique used to visualize internal structures of the body, particularly the brain.

label: Adverse Events
definition: Negative outcomes or complications that arise during the course of treatment or monitoring.

label: Admission Data
definition: Data collected at the time of patient admission to an intensive care unit, relevant for monitoring and treatment.

label: Acceptable Range
definition: A set of conditions that define the acceptable limits for recorded values in clinical monitoring.

label: End-tidal Carbon Dioxide
definition: The concentration of carbon dioxide at the end of an exhaled breath, used to monitor ventilation status.

label: Reading
definition: A recorded observation of a specific parameter and its value.

label: Skin
definition: The outer covering of the body.

label: Provenance
definition: Information describing the origin and history of data.

label: Rectal
definition: Relating to the rectum, the final section of the large intestine.
